example.title: Roy C. and Lena (Johnson) Seaman House, 400 Magnetic Avenue

brief: Side-gabled 1.5-storey Craftsman bungalow painted barn red with white trim: the roof sweeps down over a full-width recessed front porch whose low walls, piers and chimney are cobblestone/fieldstone, with a long shed dormer (two pairs of windows) above. Exposed rafter tails, wide picture windows either side of the door, stone steps. A matching red single-car garage/shed sits beside; flag on a porch pier, wagon-wheel and garden ornaments in the yard.
